scope: Behavior, ARIA, parts, events and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderer's server markup and client behavior. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: preset and parts anatomy, trigger ARIA and keys, openchange (cancelable, reason trigger-press), open / default-open / disabled, no native form elements
resolveDisclosure: 8u trigger row, caret sm, 3u / 2u panel insets
React SSR: the same data-* and recipe classes as the web component, the composed parts render the preset's markup, render and className functions, onOpenChange details

limitations: The height animation (interpolate-size, display allow-discrete) needs a real browser; unit tests cover the attributes it keys on.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []).
